summary: This document is a pre-registered hypothesis card (P10) proposing that caspase-8 loss-of-function (or pharmacologic block) abolishes FOXO4-DRI senolytic kill at least as completely as it abolishes navitoclax kill in matched senescent cultures. The claim is currently UNKNOWN/PREDICTION status — no matched head-to-head experiment has been run. The document situates this within a series (P5–P9) exploring MOMP-execution nodes in senolytic mechanisms, and explicitly flags that prior literature does not resolve this caspase-8 extrinsic-gate question.

content_blocks.title: Claim / Hypothesis Statement
content_blocks.content: On a matched senescent culture, caspase-8 loss-of-function (or pharmacologic caspase-8/death-receptor-pathway block) abolishes FOXO4-DRI senescent-cell kill at least as completely as it abolishes navitoclax kill. Pre-registered threshold: relative kill loss_FOXO4 ≥ relative kill loss_navitoclax, with each arm showing ≥20% relative kill loss vs the same senolytic on control genotype/vehicle. Execution status: NOT_RUN. This is a PREDICTION, not an observed result.

content_blocks.title: Scientific Rationale / Why It Matters
content_blocks.content: This is the next open MOMP-execution node after Bax (P7/P8) and apoptosome (P9). If caspase-8 block abolishes FOXO4-DRI ≥ navitoclax, execution is not exclusively intrinsic-MOMP. Soft-claims: FOXO4-DRI∩(caspase-8|Fas|extrinsic|RIPK|TRAIL) soft-complete = 0; matched caspase-8 LOF H2H remains UNKNOWN. P5–P9 are explicitly stated to NOT prove this extrinsic gate.

content_blocks.title: Mechanism Sketch
content_blocks.content: FOXO4-DRI enters via FOXO4–p53 axis; navitoclax via Bcl-2/Bcl-xL/Bcl-w. Both may still require caspase-8/extrinsic execution — or FOXO4-DRI may stay largely caspase-8-independent while navitoclax is abolished (or the reverse). Endothelial FOXO4-DRI work frames a p53/BCL-2/Caspase-3 cascade without a caspase-8 LOF vs navitoclax matched abolish panel. Caspase-8 knockout ablates TNF-R/Fas/DR3-induced death (Varfolomeev) as an extrinsic execution prior, not a FOXO4-DRI SC H2H.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art / Literature Baseline
content_blocks.content:
Four key references cited:
1. PMID 28340339 (Baar 2017, Cell): FOXO4-DRI perturbs FOXO4–p53 → senescent-cell apoptosis; no caspase-8 LOF arm.
2. PMID 41625068 (2025, Front Bioeng): Endothelial FOXO4-DRI framed via p53/BCL-2/Caspase-3; caspase-3 cascade ≠ caspase-8 LOF vs navitoclax H2H.
3. PMID 26711051 (Zhu 2016, Aging Cell): Navitoclax senolytic via Bcl-2/Bcl-xL/Bcl-w; cell-type restricted.
4. PMID 9729047 (Varfolomeev 1998): Caspase-8 KO ablates TNF-receptor/Fas/DR3-induced cell death — extrinsic execution prior, not a FOXO4-DRI SC matched panel.

content_blocks.title: Baseline Measured / Evidence Status
content_blocks.content: FOXO4–p53 entry: LITERATURE (PMID 28340339). Downstream BCL-2/caspase-3 framing: LITERATURE without caspase-8 LOF H2H (PMID 41625068). Navitoclax Bcl-2-family senolytic: LITERATURE (PMID 26711051). Caspase-8 KO ablates death-receptor–induced death: LITERATURE as extrinsic prior (PMID 9729047). Matched caspase-8 LOF × FOXO4-DRI vs navitoclax % kill abolish: UNKNOWN. ≥ equal abolish (loss_FOXO4 ≥ loss_nav; each ≥20% relative): PREDICTION. P5–P9 do not already prove this epistasis.

content_blocks.title: Actionable Limitations
content_blocks.content:
1. Do not treat P5–P9 as proving P10 — Bax/residual/apoptosome cards did not run caspase-8 LOF; empty soft-complete ≠ demonstrated ≥ equal abolish.
2. Caspase-3 cascade ≠ caspase-8 necessity — PMID 41625068 implicates caspase-3 without genetic extrinsic requirement or navitoclax-matched abolish.
3. Varfolomeev ≠ FOXO4-DRI panel — classical extrinsic prior is not a senolytic H2H; ≥ equal abolish is stronger than shared death-receptor language; navitoclax-insensitive SC types confound matched culture choice.

content_blocks.title: Proposed Method / Assay Design
content_blocks.content: Method type: propose-assay. Lock one senescent system sensitive to both senolytics, apply caspase-8 LOF vs pharmacologic caspase-8/death-receptor-block tool, measure viability + caspase readout. Compare FOXO4-DRI vs navitoclax under caspase-8 LOF vs control genotype/vehicle. Pre-register α/N before claiming ≥ equal abolish. Do not treat P5–P9 as proof; no dosing invented.

content_blocks.title: Refutation Criteria
content_blocks.content: Refute if: On the pre-registered matched panel, FOXO4-DRI kill largely survives caspase-8 LOF/block while navitoclax kill is abolished, OR relative kill loss_FOXO4 is below relative kill loss_navitoclax outside the pre-registered ≥ equal band — indicating pathway-sparing/caspase-8-independent FOXO4-DRI execution.

key_findings: Hypothesis P10 is a PREDICTION with execution_status=NOT_RUN — no matched caspase-8 LOF × FOXO4-DRI vs navitoclax experiment has been performed.
Soft-complete for FOXO4-DRI∩(caspase-8|Fas|extrinsic|RIPK|TRAIL) = 0; the matched caspase-8 LOF H2H remains UNKNOWN in the literature.

FOXO4-DRI mechanism enters via FOXO4–p53 axis (PMID 28340339); navitoclax via Bcl-2/Bcl-xL/Bcl-w (PMID 26711051) — distinct upstream entry points but shared downstream execution may or may not require caspase-8.
Endothelial FOXO4-DRI work (PMID 41625068) implicates caspase-3 cascade but does NOT constitute a caspase-8 LOF vs navitoclax head-to-head abolish panel.
Varfolomeev 1998 (PMID 9729047) establishes caspase-8 KO ablates death-receptor-induced death as an extrinsic execution prior — not a FOXO4-DRI senolytic matched panel.
Pre-registered threshold: relative kill loss_FOXO4 ≥ relative kill loss_navitoclax, each arm ≥20% relative kill loss vs control — neither threshold has been measured.
P5–P9 (Bax/residual/apoptosome cards) explicitly do NOT prove caspase-8 extrinsic gate epistasis for P10.
Estimated time to refute: 4 weeks; kill_cost_tier=1 (low cost experiment).
TRL assessment: This is TRL 1 — pure conceptual hypothesis with literature-only support; no experimental data generated for this specific claim.
